The answer is C: using water may cause electrolyte imbalance. Water is hypotonic, so it can be absorbed through the bladder wall, which can cause hyponatraemia and water intoxication. That is why sterile 0.9% sodium chloride is the standard irrigation fluid. Fluid bypassing the catheter (A) isn't a risk specific to water, so I'm sticking with C.

CONFIDENCE: 75
